observations: Photo 0: Black portable keyboard resting on an orange plastic chair, 'YAMAHA' logo visible on upper left of the control panel.
Photo 1: Close view of keyboard's right side and front edge showing 'YAMAHA' wordmark in white letters, plus a small LED display and control buttons.
Photo 2: Close-up of keys and control panel again showing 'YAMAHA' logo clearly on the body.
Keyboard has 49 or so mini/full-size keys, a small LCD screen, and sound/voice selection charts printed in purple and teal strips.
Some keys appear slightly yellowed or worn, consistent with age/used condition.
No power adapter, stand, or box visible in any photo.
No visible model number or serial sticker readable in any image.

claims.evidence: Brand 'Yamaha' is visible in photos 0-2, but no evidence supports the 'professional' grade claim; looks like a standard home/portable keyboard.
All three photos show the 'YAMAHA' logo printed directly on the instrument body (photo 0, 1, 2); no Casio branding appears anywhere.

response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a Yamaha portable keyboard from the visible branding in all three photos, directly contradicting the stray claim that the brand is Casio; since working condition and exact model are unverified, it should be priced at the worst-case (untested, base-model) level for a used Yamaha portable keyboard.
